name: Rickard Ashet
desc: Rickard Ashet is an Adretian Fleet Admiral who served in [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority) navy, before later retiring.
additional_info: -   Rickard Ashet is a reference to a leak where an Adret named Rick Ashet fights a Crustaceous Rex, as well as being a pun on the word _ricochet_.
